title: What are some "No AI" apps/companies/resources you know of?
content: <p>Hey everyone I'm wondering if there's any useful/helpful list of apps, companies, or resources in general that avoid AI (they don't have to be vocally or openly "anti", but at least explicitly avoid it) that you know of?</p> <p>I'm not looking to start a discussion on what's good/bad or (un)worthy about AI, or who's for/against, just links and/or communities promoting this sentiment/position.</p> <p>For example, <a href="https://www.rebeltechalliance.org" rel="ugc">https://www.rebeltechalliance.org</a> would be one of those resources.</p> <p>Thank you!</p>
summary: A Lobsters post asking for lists of apps, companies, or resources that explicitly avoid AI, with the author clarifying they want links and communities rather than debate about AI's merits, and giving Rebel Tech Alliance as an example.
highlights: Seeks useful lists of apps, companies, or resources that avoid AI
Not looking to debate AI's good/bad or for/against positions
Wants links and communities promoting the no-AI sentiment
Cites rebeltechalliance.org as an example resource
